notablePrerequisites: You control creatures that can produce at least {2}{G}.
description:
Activate any number creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}.
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
